task: Continue the recovered cruush v2 crypto payment implementation. Slices now include the disabled-by-default watch-only Base USDC and Ethereum PYUSD rails, the seamless no-voucher cruush+ store checkout, ERC-681 payment URIs and QR codes, and the disabled-by-default chain watcher, settlement policy, entitlement grant, and reconciliation and support lookup. Accept no funds and make no live RPC call.
decisions: Checkout is seamless and account-linked; no voucher or promo-code issuance flow
Initial wallet rails are USDC on Base and PYUSD on Ethereum; both are watch-only EVM receiving rails
The client may request a named rail, but the server maps it to fixed asset, network, chain, and token metadata
Every intent receives a unique address derived from a watch-only account xpub
The cruush application and server never receive a seed phrase, private key, or raw card data
Wallet custody is software-only with a zero-dollar hardware and provider budget
A separate local operator tool may handle recovery words transiently through an interactive terminal, but never stores them, accepts them through arguments or environment variables, or deploys them
Initial transaction signing is limited to Base Sepolia and never broadcasts
Settlement evidence is chain logs read by the server; a browser poll, copied address, or member-supplied transaction hash is never evidence
The entitlement grant is shared with the existing checkout path through grantCruushPlusPlan, so the two cannot drift
Grant idempotency is enforced by database constraints, not only by application logic
Settlement policy values are engineering defaults standing in for product decisions and need Julien's sign-off
The watcher starts only when the processor is enabled, the watcher is enabled, and a chain endpoint is configured
cruush does not refund cruush+, a digital good delivered immediately; no refund flow, tooling, or copy is built (standing invariant G7)
The refunded payment state is unreachable record-keeping only, kept so an exceptional hand-made refund can be recorded truthfully

The no-refunds position depends on checkout capturing prior express consent to immediate performance plus acknowledgement of losing the EU withdrawal right; that consent flow is a payment-launch gate and is not built
Arbitrum is the primary rail: it is the only network Cash App, Venmo, and PayPal can all send to, and its fees are negligible where mainnet charges per sale forever
The checkout asks which app someone is paying from, never which chain or coin
nonGoals: No real seed phrase, private key, xprv, wallet credential value, or production address in source, tests, configuration, logs, tool arguments, tool environment variables, chat, or agent-visible output; public deterministic test vectors are test-only
No persistent digital recovery-word or private-key vault in this slice
No agent execution of secret-bearing wallet commands
No Base mainnet transaction signing or transaction broadcast
No third-party crypto provider adapter or provider API calls
No card form or raw card data anywhere in cruush
No commit, push, merge, deployment, production activation, or live payment
No live RPC call, no chain endpoint configured, and no provider selected in this slice
No refund flow, refund tooling, or refund-offering copy; refunds are not offered for cruush+
proof: Focused public-vector wallet derivation, Base Sepolia constrained-signing, crypto core, route, config, checkout API, and checkout component tests; local wallet tool, server, and client builds; secret and deployment-boundary scans; rendered local /store inspection at desktop and 360x740 mobile. No agent runs wallet initialization. Payment activation, recovery drill, security review, real-wallet receipt, mainnet signing, and broadcast remain unverified.
environmentChanges: CRYPTO_PROCESSOR_WALLET_XPUB is new, server-only, empty by default, and must never contain an xprv
CRYPTO_PROCESSOR_BASE_RPC_URL is new, server-only, empty by default, and may embed an API key
CRYPTO_PROCESSOR_ETHEREUM_RPC_URL is new, server-only, empty by default, and may embed an API key
CRYPTO_PROCESSOR_WATCHER_ENABLED is new, server-only, and false by default
CRYPTO_PROCESSOR_WATCHER_INTERVAL_SECONDS is new, server-only, and defaults to 30
CRYPTO_PROCESSOR_ARBITRUM_RPC_URL is new, server-only, empty by default, and may embed an API key
objective: Complete the disabled-by-default in-house crypto payment processor for cruush+: watch-only USDC on Base and PYUSD on Ethereum receiving rails, an account-linked no-voucher /store checkout with ERC-681 payment URIs and QR codes, a chain settlement watcher, an idempotent entitlement grant, and reconciliation with moderator support lookup. Accept no funds and make no live RPC call.
userOutcome: Julien can accept cruush+ payments in stablecoin without a card processor, and can answer 'I paid and got nothing' from a support lookup instead of reading the chain by hand. Nothing is live until he supplies a wallet xpub and a chain endpoint.
audience: Julien as operator; cruush members buying cruush+ once the processor is enabled.
nextVisibleMilestone: Julien sets a chain RPC endpoint and a watch-only wallet xpub, after which the disabled /store checkout can be enabled and exercised end to end on a local stack.
successCriteria: The processor stays disabled and accepts no funds until Julien enables it
A payment intent receives a unique receiving address that settles only that order
Entitlement is granted once and only once, from confirmed chain evidence alone
Support can find a payment by intent, member, address, or transaction hash
Running the watcher costs nothing while no payment is in progress
mustPreserve: Existing billing prices and entitlement behavior remain authoritative
Existing rewards and checkout routes remain unchanged except for the new /store route
Processor stays disabled unless valid watch-only configuration is present
The production server remains watch-only and receives no signing dependency or signing endpoint
The local software-wallet tool is excluded from server build and runtime images
All unrelated dirty work and worktrees remain untouched
Existing checkout and entitlement behaviour is unchanged by the shared grant extraction
Unrelated dirty work, other worktrees, and other sessions' stashes stay untouched
requiredEvidence: Focused server, client, and wallet-tool tests pass for every touched file
Server and client production builds pass
Database settlement guards proven against a live local database by attempting to violate them
Rendered local /store inspected at desktop and 360x740
stopConditions: Any step would require a seed phrase, private key, xprv, or other wallet signing material
Any step would make a live RPC call, broadcast a transaction, or move real funds
Any step would push, deploy, or enable the processor in production

assumptions.statement: Dwellir is the chosen RPC provider on its free tier; its European status was not verified from a primary source.
assumptions.impact: If EU-vendor status matters, the provider may need swapping; this is one environment variable.

assumptions.statement: Confirmation targets of 30 on Base and 12 on Ethereum, 50 bps underpayment tolerance capped at $0.25, and a 7 day late-arrival watch window.
assumptions.impact: These decide when money counts as paid and when a member is short; Julien asked for a pick rather than options.

assumptions.statement: The no-refunds position for a digital good requires checkout to capture prior express consent to immediate performance plus acknowledgement of losing the EU withdrawal right; that consent flow is not built.
assumptions.impact: Without it the no-refunds position is asserted rather than held in EU jurisdictions.
